messages:
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT: spike in 429/503 for /v1/generate across hosted region us-west-2 — rolling alert at 1772145623. Initial 429 rate 5.8% over last 5m. Pager: @alex @priya
Alex R.: on it, climbing. grabbing dashboards.
Alex R.: Grafana link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rl/traffic?orgId=1&from=now-10m&to=now — 429s mainly from a pattern of sudden bursty token requests from a handful of tenants.
Priya K.: I see the same in request logs — repeated short sequences from tenant:t-84 and t-112. High concurrency.
Jamie L.: tagging @maria for customer-impact/CS heads-up. Maria S.: noted, will prep comms if scope grows. Which tenants are erroring vs throttled?
Alex R.: t-84 and t-112 show 429 + occasional 503s. Third-party retries causing load. I can apply a soft throttle per-tenant to shed excess QPS. 
Priya K.: agree. Proposed live mitigation: 1) add strict tenant-level burst quota on t-84/t-112 (50 req/s) 2) enable global short-term ingress token-bucket (burst 500, refill 200/s) 3) temporarily disable background telemetry fanout to reduce downstream pressure.
Jamie L.: sounds good. Any rollback plan?
Alex R.: yes, commands below. rollback = remove quota override and re-enable telemetry. Will watch 5m windows.
Priya K.: runbook snippet:
```
# apply tenant throttle
redwoodctl tenants quota set --tenant t-84 --qps 50 --burst 100
redwoodctl tenants quota set --tenant t-112 --qps 50 --burst 100
# toggle telemetry
redwoodctl flags set disable-telemetry-fanout true --scope global
```
Alex R.: applying now for t-84 -> executing.
SRE-Bot: Action executed by alex at 1772145681: tenant quota update queued.
Alex R.: done for t-84, now t-112.
SRE-Bot: Action executed by alex at 1772145694: tenant quota update queued.
Priya K.: enabling short-term ingress throttle (global) now.
SRE-Bot: Action executed by priya at 1772145702: global ingress rate limit policy applied.
Alex R.: telemetry flag toggled.
Oncall Swap Bot: Reminder: shift handoff @1772145760 — if mitigation ongoing, please coordinate.
Maria S.: customer impact: t-84 experiencing partial degraded requests, some requests retried by client. Enterprise customer rep alerted.
Matt D.: quick note — disabled a low-value streaming feature for anonymous traffic earlier as an extra soft-shed. Command: `redwoodctl features toggle --name anon-streaming --off`
Alex R.: watching Grafana now. 429 rate dropped from 5.8% -> 1.3% over 3 minutes, 503s fell to near baseline. dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/snapshots/abc123
Priya K.: good trend. still seeing a handful of retries causing bursts, but below SLO impact for most customers.
Jamie L.: please post list of tenants that had overrides so CS can follow up + ask them to implement exponential backoff.
Alex R.: overrides: t-84, t-112, plus temporary global ingress policy. Will paste policy IDs in a sec.
Alex R.: policy ids: quota-ov-1772145681, quota-ov-1772145694, ingress-short-1772145702.
Maria S.: ack. I'll draft outreach for t-84/t-112 (internal rep + suggested client change).
Priya K.: monitoring: set alert to page if 429 > 2% for 10m sustained. Lowered threshold temporarily.
SRE-Bot: Alert rule update executed by priya at 1772145735: rule_id=alert-429-threshold-temp.
Oncall Swap Bot: @alex — shift handoff in 3m. If you want to handoff, confirm next oncall.
Alex R.: handing off to @matt. Matt are you taking it?
Matt D.: taking it. please include current runbook actions and links.
Alex R.: handing over: mitigation applied (see policy ids), telemetry off, anon streaming disabled, 429s reduced to ~1.1%. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rl/traffic?from=now-15m
Matt D.: thanks. I'll keep the throttles for 20m and start a controlled rollback if trend stable. If 429s spike again, increase tenant throttle to 30 qps.
Priya K.: FYI, we should follow up with infra to add token-bucket smoothing in the edge LB — saved us today but manual. filing infra ticket after incident.
Jamie L.: can someone capture a short incident timeline for postmortem? I can draft.
Alex R.: timeline (short): 1772145600 — sudden burst detected; 1772145623 — pager; 1772145681/94 — tenant quotas applied; 1772145702 — global ingress throttle; 1772145735 — alert threshold temp lowered; 1772145780 — telemetry disabled; 1772145820 — 429s trending down; 1772145860 — handoff to matt; 1772145890 — monitoring stable.
Maria S.: CS action: reach out to t-84/t-112 PMs, recommend client backoff + batching fix.
Matt D.: will keep 20m watch, then start rolling rollback: re-enable telemetry, remove tenant quotas, re-enable anon streaming in that order.
Priya K.: also propose gating realtime rerouting (non-critical) behind capacity checks — file for roadmap.
Alex R.: thanks all. I'll update thread if anything changes.
SRE-Bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV4 at 1772145898 — mitigation holding.
Jamie L.: great job team :thumbsup: — please add notes to incident tracker and schedule a 1hr postmortem tomorrow.
Maria S.: adding customer comms to tracker.
Matt D.: closing monitoring loop — will post final metrics and follow-ups in the incident doc.
Alex R.: final snapshot: 429 rate steady at 1.0%, 503 <0.1%. closing active mitigation but keep watch.
